title: Mobile Forensic Evidence BENCH™
meta_title: Mobile Forensic Evidence Bench - Air Science Safefume Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chambers
meta_description: The Air Science Evidence BENCH™ series of laboratory work tables is designed specifically for high volume processing of forensic evidence by multiple users. Professional design and construction features offer convenience during use, cleaning and maintenance.
meta_keywords: forensic evidence bench, mobile forensic workstation, cyanoacrylate fuming chamber, fingerprint processing equipment
short_description: The Air Science Evidence BENCH™ series of laboratory work tables is designed specifically for high volume processing of forensic evidence by multiple users. Professional design and construction features offer convenience during use, cleaning and maintenance.
full_description:
No positive airflow
Fabric withstands decontamination with standard bleach solution to eliminate blood-borne pathogens and DNA cross-contamination.
Cabinet includes plastic hangers, a plastic zipper designed for tamperproof seals, hanging rod, push handle, locking wheels, evidence tray and biological hazard warning label.
seo_content: The Air Science Evidence BENCH™ series provides a versatile and durable solution for forensic investigation and processing. Designed with professional-grade construction and features, these mobile work tables offer convenience, safety, and efficiency for high-volume evidence processing. With options for customization and compliance with industry standards, the Evidence BENCH™ is an essential tool for modern forensic labs and crime scene investigation teams.
